Prop29 and Prop34 variants build fine! The culprit is elsewhere in Prop46's unique chain — likely `Book1.Prop46.Main` (non-variant). Let me test it.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== Book1.Prop46.Main ====="; timeout 250 lake build Book1.Prop46.Main > /tmp/bp46.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -aoE "\[[0-9]+/[0-9]+\] (Building|Replayed|Built) [A-Za-z0-9._]+" /tmp/bp46.log | tail -3; echo "===== Book1.Prop11.Main (dep) ====="; timeout 200 lake build Book1Variants.Prop11 > /tmp/bp11.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
